Add notes templates feature

This patch introduces the ability to specify a template that should
be used when a new note is created.
The templates/ directory has two samples, and if the autogen parameter
is != 0 the sample will be generated within the notes_folder working
dir.

Migrate window manager configuration from i3 to Sway for Wayland support

This commit introduces Sway window manager configuration to replace X11-based i3:

- Add sway/config: Complete Sway configuration with Wayland-compatible keybindings,
  workspace management, and input handling. Replaces X11-specific commands with
  Wayland equivalents (swaymsg, swaylock, brightnessctl)

- Add scripts/i3scripts/dockland.sh: Enhanced multi-monitor management script
  using swaymsg commands for output configuration. Supports dock/undock modes,
  display mirroring, and flexible positioning for external monitors

- Add sway/sway-defaults: Environment setup script for Wayland session with
  proper XDG directories, GPG agent configuration, and Sway socket management

Fix git-clone-review function when there's no PS number

When the patchset number doesn't exist yet, we might be want
to clone a given repo passing a topic which results in a failure
when git review -d is invoked.
This patch allows to continue the function execution even when
git review -d fails, checking out on the specified topic.
